item.title: Research Publication: Malnutrition and Type 2 Diabetes Across Global Populations
item.dc:creator: Oluwole Fasakin
item.description: Systematic review of observational evidence on malnutrition and type 2 diabetes mellitus across diverse global populations. Frontiers in Clinical Diabetes and Healthcare, 2026. Research role included meta-analysis, scoping review, a geographic distribution map, and risk-of-bias plots.
